morphology.pattern_note: 依资料包将其登记为词汇化整词；内部仍可分析为 misal + -nya。这里 -nya 不表示复数，马来西亚常见读音为 /ɲə/；阿拉伯式读法可保留 /θ/。

senses.zh_definition: 例如；比如；用于引出说明前述一般情况的具体例子。
senses.en_definition: For example; for instance; introducing a specific illustration.
senses.nuances: 可用作句首或句中的举例标记。misalnya 引出例子；若要提出纯粹假设，andaikata 或 sekiranya 通常更明确。词义依据：[PRPM：misal](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/cari1/cari1/Cari1/Cari1/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=misal)。

collocations.en: fruit, for example mangoes and bananas

etymology.historical_story: Misalnya belongs to the misal family, connected with Arabic mithāl, meaning an example or likeness. DBP also records amsal as an Arabic plural related to misal. In Malay, the established expression misal plus -nya introduces an illustration rather than requiring a literal possessive translation. It therefore works naturally as the discourse expression for example. [DBP: amsal](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=73980&keyword=amsal), [DBP: misal](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/cari1/cari1/Cari1/Cari1/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=misal)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 先记 misal 是“例子”，再把 misalnya 整块记成“比如说”；看到它，就等后面的具体例子。

cultural_pragmatics.politeness_note: 语气中性，适合课堂、报告与聊天。向长辈或上级说明时，可直接使用 misalnya，无须添加口语语气词。
cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 所举例子应与前述类别一致。涉及族群、宗教或个人时，宜选择具体事实，避免用单一例子概括整个群体。
